chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said:
The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “There is no amputation for one who steals stone — meaning marble and the like.”

key_terms.أَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ: Similar things; comparable materials included in the same ruling
key_terms.الرُّخَامَ: Marble; a specific example explaining the type of stone intended
key_terms.الْحِجَارَةَ: Stone; the stolen material referred to in the ruling
key_terms.لَا قَطْعَ: No amputation; the legal hadd penalty is not applied here

ai.seo_question: Does the hadd punishment of theft apply to someone who steals marble or stone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning theft and states that the hadd punishment of amputation does not apply to one who steals stone, such as marble and similar materials. It is significant in fiqh because it clarifies limits and conditions in the application of theft penalties.
